title: Preserve the nonsharp quarter-step population certificate
statement: For g(r)=phi(sqrt(r)),the exact-law bound is V4(P_r)>=max{2g(r),(8/5)[r+g(r)]}. Its second term improves V2=2g(r)when g(r)<4r. For the constructed r~.04294297834,V2~.1742961nats per recorded interval and the quarter lower bound~.2081456,about19.42%higher;the actual CTMC spends~21.70mean nats per interval. This is a source-specific comparison of population minima/lower bounds,not a sharp quarter optimum or finite-data mean-rate result. A calibrated realised-path transfer for this quarter bound is not supplied.
